title: The Bilinear Lower-Central-Series Bound (lowerCentralSeries_commutator_le)
content: The headline result: ⁅γₐ, γᵦ⁆ ≤ γ₍ₐ₊ᵦ₊₁₎ in Mathlib's 0-indexed convention (the textbook 1-indexed ⁅γᵢ, γⱼ⁆ ≤ γ₍ᵢ₊ⱼ₎). The proof is induction on b, generalized over a so the inductive hypothesis is the universally quantified ∀ a, ⁅γₐ, γᵦ⁆ ≤ γ₍ₐ₊ᵦ₊₁₎ and is therefore available at the shifted index a+1. Base case b=0: γ₀ = ⊤ and a+0+1 = a+1, so the goal ⁅γₐ, ⊤⁆ ≤ γ₍ₐ₊₁₎ is the definitional recursion lowerCentralSeries G (a+1) = ⁅γₐ, ⊤⁆ (closed by le_of_eq rfl). Inductive step: present γ₍ᵦ₊₁₎ as ⁅γᵦ, ⊤⁆ and flip the goal ⁅γₐ, ⁅γᵦ,⊤⁆⁆ to ⁅⁅γᵦ,⊤⁆, γₐ⁆ via commutator_comm, then apply the parent's relative three subgroups lemma ThreeSubgroupsLemmaOQ01.commutator_le_of_rotate with H=⊤, K=γₐ, L=γᵦ at target N = γ₍ₐ₊(ᵦ₊₁)₊₁₎ (normal by lowerCentralSeries_normal). Its two hypotheses are exactly the induction hypothesis: ⁅⁅⊤,γₐ⁆,γᵦ⁆ = ⁅γ₍ₐ₊₁₎, γᵦ⁆ ≤ N is the hypothesis at index a+1 (after the index identity a+1+b+1 = a+(b+1)+1), and ⁅⁅γₐ,γᵦ⁆,⊤⁆ ≤ ⁅γ₍ₐ₊ᵦ₊₁₎,⊤⁆ = γ₍ₐ₊ᵦ₊₂₎ = N is the hypothesis at index a pushed one step by commutator_mono.
mathContext: $\lbrack \gamma_a, \gamma_b \rbrack \le \gamma_{a+b+1}$ for the lower central series; equivalently the textbook $\lbrack \gamma_i, \gamma_j \rbrack \le \gamma_{i+j}$.
prerequisites: Mathlib's lowerCentralSeries (0-indexed: γ₀ = ⊤, γ₍ₙ₊₁₎ = ⁅γₙ, ⊤⁆) with lowerCentralSeries_zero and the definitional succ unfolding
lowerCentralSeries_normal (each term is normal in G), needed to invoke the relative three subgroups lemma
The parent entry's ThreeSubgroupsLemmaOQ01.commutator_le_of_rotate, plus Subgroup.commutator_mono and Subgroup.commutator_comm
significance: The bilinear grading bound of the lower central series, which Mathlib does not record. It is the concrete inductive payoff the parent entry's relative (≤ N) three subgroups lemma was built for, and the structural fact that makes ⨁ₖ γₖ/γₖ₊₁ a graded Lie ring.

title: Symmetric, Corner, and Weakened Forms
content: Three immediate consequences. lowerCentralSeries_commutator_le' is the symmetric companion with the two factors swapped, ⁅γᵦ, γₐ⁆ ≤ γ₍ₐ₊ᵦ₊₁₎, obtained by a single commutator_comm rewrite. lowerCentralSeries_commutator_top_le records the b=0 corner ⁅γₐ, ⊤⁆ ≤ γ₍ₐ₊₁₎ — the commutator of a weight-a term with the whole group lands one level deeper — which holds by the defining recursion (le_of_eq rfl). lowerCentralSeries_commutator_le_of_le weakens the target to any smaller index: since the lower central series is antitone (decreasing), c ≤ a+b+1 gives γ₍ₐ₊ᵦ₊₁₎ ≤ γ_c, so ⁅γₐ, γᵦ⁆ ≤ γ_c, by composing the bilinear bound with lowerCentralSeries_antitone.
significance: Packages the bound in the orientations downstream proofs typically need: either factor order, the familiar one-step corner, and the antitone weakening that lets the bound be applied against any sufficiently shallow target term.
